q: Which payment methods are growing fastest this month compared to last month? Show percentage growth.
sql: SELECT payment_method, COALESCE((COUNT(CASE WHEN transaction_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN transaction_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND transaction_date < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) THEN 1 END), 0) - 1), 0) AS growth_percentage FROM silver_transactions WHERE transaction_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '2 months') AND transaction_date < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 month' AND payment_method IS NOT NULL GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY growth_percentage DESC;

q: Which 5 merchants have the highest refund rate? Show refund count and total transaction count.
sql: SELECT merchant_id, merchant_name, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refund_count, COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id) AS total_transaction_count, (SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'REFUNDED' THEN 1.0 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT transaction_id), 0)) * 100 AS refund_rate_pct FROM merchants JOIN silver_transactions ON merchants.merchant_id = silver_transactions.merchant_id WHERE quality_flag = 'PASS' AND transaction_date BETWEEN DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE) AND CURRENT_DATE AND status IS NOT NULL AND transaction_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY merchant_id, merchant_name ORDER BY refund_rate_pct DESC LIMIT 5;
